Name: Turnkey
Description: Watch and steer T3 Code threads from Stream Deck: thread status, stop, prompts, model options and answers, across every provider.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.slot.Name: Thread
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.slot.Tooltip: One thread from the board, filled by key position: status, title and timer. Tap opens it in T3 Code; hold selects it.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.activity.Name: Activity
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.activity.Tooltip: The most urgent thread matching a filter. Tap opens it in T3 Code.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.new.Name: New Thread
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.new.Tooltip: Starts a new thread in the selected thread's project, no project, or a chosen one; with a saved prompt or empty.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.send.Name: Send Prompt
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.send.Tooltip: Sends your own prompt, or an everyday one (continue, fix tests, explain, commit…), to the selected thread. Hold to interrupt and restart with it.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.steer.Name: Steer
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.steer.Tooltip: Adds a saved instruction to the selected thread's running turn.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.skill.Name: Run Skill
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.skill.Tooltip: Runs one of the thread's provider skills, the way picking it in T3 Code's composer and sending does.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.stop.Name: Stop
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.stop.Tooltip: Stops the selected thread's running turn, or the workflows it runs (Claude), as its Stops setting picks. Hold to stop a workflow.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.model.Name: Model
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.model.Tooltip: Switches the selected thread to a favorite model, or to the next of T3 Code's favorites.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.effort.Name: Effort
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.effort.Tooltip: Sets the selected thread's reasoning effort, or steps through what its model offers.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.speed.Name: Speed
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.speed.Tooltip: Toggles fast mode on the selected thread where its model offers it.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.permissions.Name: Permissions
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.permissions.Tooltip: Sets the selected thread's access, from Supervised to Full access, or steps through them.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.plan.Name: Plan
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.plan.Tooltip: Switches the selected thread between Build and Plan.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.approve.Name: Approve
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.approve.Tooltip: Answers the selected thread's approval as far as its settings allow, or opens it in T3 Code.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.organize.Name: Organize
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.organize.Tooltip: Settles, pins, snoozes, archives or marks the selected thread unread, or wakes the thread snoozed last.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.fork.Name: Fork
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.fork.Tooltip: Forks the thread from its newest finished reply and opens the fork, or merges a fork back into the thread it came from (hold).

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.branch.Name: Branch
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.branch.Tooltip: The selected thread's branch. Tap opens the thread in T3 Code.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.git.Name: Git
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.git.Tooltip: Commits, pushes, creates a PR or pulls the selected thread's branch, as its Action setting picks. Hold to push.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.pr.Name: Pull Request
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.pr.Tooltip: The selected thread's pull request and its state; tap opens it. Or hands it to an agent: fix findings (hold), explain, ask, or a review guide.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.task.Name: Run Task
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.task.Tooltip: One of T3 Code's scheduled tasks: its name and when it runs next. Press runs it now.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.usage.Name: Usage
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.usage.Tooltip: A period's API-estimate cost, tokens and sessions, as T3 Code's Usage shows them, on one machine or all. Tap refreshes; hold also reloads model prices.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.limits.Name: Limits
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.limits.Tooltip: A provider's subscription limit, pooled like T3 Code's Limits: % left, next reset and banked resets. Tap refreshes; hold opens T3 Code's Usage or uses a reset.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.open.Name: Open
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.open.Tooltip: Opens the selected thread's worktree in an editor, or its preview page in this computer's browser, as its In setting picks.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.health.Name: Health
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.health.Tooltip: The connection to T3 Code and its providers: the worst problem first (offline, needs pairing, not authenticated, unsupported version, unavailable). Tap reconnects.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.update.Name: Update T3
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.update.Tooltip: T3 Code's version on a machine. Hold updates it to the newest release; needs update access, asked for at that machine's next pairing.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.script.Name: Run Script
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.script.Tooltip: Runs one of the project's saved scripts in the thread's terminal; hold stops it. Needs terminal access (shell), asked for at that machine's next pairing.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.share.Name: Share Thread
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.share.Tooltip: Makes a guest link for the thread and copies it; shows Shared and its guest. Hold stops sharing. Needs guest link access, asked for at that machine's next pairing.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.threads.Name: Threads Dial
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.threads.Tooltip: Rotate through the threads that match its filter, selecting them in T3 Code; press or tap to open one.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.model.Name: Power Dial
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.model.Tooltip: Changes the selected thread's model, effort or access; press or tap switches Speed where offered.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.prompts.Name: Prompts Dial
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.prompts.Tooltip: Rotate through your prompts and templates. Press sends to the selected thread; hold starts a new thread.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.answer.Name: Answer Dial
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.answer.Tooltip: Answers an agent's question choice by choice, and approvals as far as its settings allow.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.queue.Name: Queue Dial
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.queue.Tooltip: Rotate through the selected thread's queued messages. Press sends one now (steering it in, or starting it while nothing runs); hold removes it.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.tasks.Name: Tasks Dial
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.tasks.Tooltip: Rotate through T3 Code's scheduled tasks, with when each runs next. Press runs the shown task now; tap turns it off or back on.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.skills.Name: Skills Dial
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.skills.Tooltip: Rotate through the thread's provider skills. Press or tap runs the shown one; touch and hold reads its description.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.pr.Name: PR Dial
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.pr.Tooltip: Rotate through open pull requests. Press runs Fix findings, tap opens it in the browser, touch and hold reads its findings.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.limits.Name: Limits Dial
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.limits.Tooltip: Rotate through every provider's limit windows. Press or tap refreshes; hold the press to open T3 Code's Usage or use a reset.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.usage.Name: Usage Dial
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.usage.Tooltip: Rotate through a period's total and each model's cost, tokens, cache hit rate and cost per million tokens. Press or tap refreshes; a long press reloads model prices.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.devices.Name: Devices Dial
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.dial.devices.Tooltip: Rotate through T3 Code's simulators and emulators. Press starts the shown one, or opens it, in the thread's Device panel; hold powers it off. Touch looks for devices again.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.git.commit.Name: Git
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.git.commit.Tooltip: Commits, pushes, creates a PR or pulls the selected thread's branch, as its Action setting picks. Hold to push.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.git.push.Name: Git
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.git.push.Tooltip: Commits, pushes, creates a PR or pulls the selected thread's branch, as its Action setting picks. Hold to push.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.git.pr.Name: Git
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.git.pr.Tooltip: Commits, pushes, creates a PR or pulls the selected thread's branch, as its Action setting picks. Hold to push.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.git.pull.Name: Git
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.git.pull.Tooltip: Commits, pushes, creates a PR or pulls the selected thread's branch, as its Action setting picks. Hold to push.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.pr.fix.Name: Pull Request
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.pr.fix.Tooltip: The selected thread's pull request and its state; tap opens it. Or hands it to an agent: fix findings (hold), explain, ask, or a review guide.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.pr.explain.Name: Pull Request
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.pr.explain.Tooltip: The selected thread's pull request and its state; tap opens it. Or hands it to an agent: fix findings (hold), explain, ask, or a review guide.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.pr.ask.Name: Pull Request
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.pr.ask.Tooltip: The selected thread's pull request and its state; tap opens it. Or hands it to an agent: fix findings (hold), explain, ask, or a review guide.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.pr.guide.Name: Pull Request
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.pr.guide.Tooltip: The selected thread's pull request and its state; tap opens it. Or hands it to an agent: fix findings (hold), explain, ask, or a review guide.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.quick.Name: Send Prompt
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.quick.Tooltip: Sends your own prompt, or an everyday one (continue, fix tests, explain, commit…), to the selected thread. Hold to interrupt and restart with it.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.workflow.stop.Name: Stop
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.workflow.stop.Tooltip: Stops the selected thread's running turn, or the workflows it runs (Claude), as its Stops setting picks. Hold to stop a workflow.

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.merge.Name: Fork
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.merge.Tooltip: Forks the thread from its newest finished reply and opens the fork, or merges a fork back into the thread it came from (hold).

com.alejandrom2.turnkey.editor.Name: Open
com.alejandrom2.turnkey.editor.Tooltip: Opens the selected thread's worktree in an editor, or its preview page in this computer's browser, as its In setting picks.

devices.title: Devices
devices.hubFailed: The device hub failed to start.

devices.physical: Can't power off a real device

editor.label: Editor
editor.hint: Opens the selected thread's worktree, or its project's folder. T3 Code launches the editor on its own machine, which may not be this one.

devices.hint: Lists the simulators and emulators of the thread's machine and its device hosts. Press starts the shown device in the thread's Device panel, or opens it there if it runs; hold powers it off. A cloud (EAS) device needs a hold to start, since Expo bills while it runs. Turning Devices on and adding hosts happens in T3 Code.

preview.hint: Opens the page the thread's preview panel shows in this computer's browser, else the thread's newest HTML render. A page on another machine's localhost only opens on that machine, so the key says so; open it from T3 Code there.

pr.fixHint: Sends T3 Code's Fix findings task for the selected thread's pull request to that thread, queued if it is busy. Review comments and check output come from the host and are attached as untrusted data.
pr.dialHint: Lists open pull requests on the machine. Press runs Fix findings in the thread linked to it, or in a new worktree thread; tap opens it in the browser; touch and hold reads its findings.

git.messagePlaceholder: Written by T3 Code when empty
git.hint: Acts on the selected thread's worktree, or its project's folder. Pushing to the default branch always needs a hold; a PR from it is refused, as T3 Code would offer a new branch first.
git.pullHint: Pulls the selected thread's branch from its upstream when it is behind.

card.looking: Looking for T3 Code on this machine…
card.linkPlaceholder: Paste a pair link from Settings → Sharing & access
card.accessHelp: Turnkey asks to read threads and act on them, within what the link allows. Revoke it in Settings → Sharing & access.
card.notRunning: T3 Code isn't running on this machine. Open it, or paste a pair link from another machine below.
card.howToPair: In T3 Code, open Settings → Sharing & access, create a pair link, and paste it below.
card.pasteFromMachine: Paste a pair link from this machine below.
card.verboseUntil: On until {time}, then back to normal logging.
card.verboseOff: Logs more detail for 24 hours, then turns itself off. Never logs tokens.
card.diagnosticsFailed: That didn't work. Open the logs folder to look yourself.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.exportHint: Saves versions, machines (host, state and access only), action counts and recent errors to a file in the logs folder and shows it. Tokens, pair links and full addresses are left out, so it is safe to attach to a bug report.

settings.blocked: Stream Deck didn't open the window.
settings.title: Turnkey Settings
settings.detached: Open Turnkey settings from a Turnkey action.
settings.machinesLede: Turnkey connects to T3 Code on each machine you add. Every key and dial can follow one machine, or all of them.

advanced.appLinkHint: Use t3code-dev to open threads in a development build.
advanced.stateHint: Dark is a plain near-black, like Stream Deck's own strips. Flow draws one picture across neighboring dials. Thread state tints a strip green when an unseen turn is done, red when failed and amber when it needs you. Each dial can override this in its own settings.
advanced.styleHint: List turns through a dial's items like a wheel, Carousel shows each as a tile between its neighbors. Per dial default uses List for the Threads dial, Classic for the others; Classic shows the Power dial as a slider. Long text moves once the dial rests, twice, then stops; touch and hold the strip to read it all, and turn to scroll.
advanced.maxEffortHint: Gradient colors every effort level along a ladder in the model's own color, turning toward violet at the top, and gives each model and Fast its provider's gradient. Solid and Model color mark only the top effort level, in violet or the model's color; Off leaves them plain. Ultrathink keeps T3 Code's spectrum.
advanced.motionHint: Full spins running threads, pulses threads waiting on you and flashes finishes and failures. Reduced spins slowly and doesn't pulse. Off keeps every face still.
advanced.idlePetHint: After two minutes without a press, turn or touch, a small robot walks across your longest row of neighboring dial strips, up to three times, four minutes apart. Any press, turn or touch on a Turnkey action sends it away. It follows Motion: Reduced walks calmly, Off keeps it away.
advanced.autoSwitchHint: Puts each Stream Deck on its Turnkey profile when T3 Code opens, and back on the profile before when it quits. A deck you moved to another profile meanwhile stays where it is.
advanced.confirmHint: Applies to Send Prompt, Steer, Run Skill, the Prompts dial and the Skills dial; Model, Effort, Speed, Access and the Power dial always apply at once. Review shows what goes where on the first press; press again within 10 seconds to send. Hold sends on a held press, so holding can't also restart or start a thread. Each action can override this.

filter.attention: Needs you: approval, question, failure or unread result

slot.label: Slot
slot.hint: By key position fills Thread keys left to right, top to bottom. Threads are ordered: needs approval, has a question, running, then the rest. Tap opens, hold selects.

activity.hint: Shows the most urgent matching thread. More Activity keys with the same settings show the next ones, by key position.

answer.hint: Turn between this choice and Deny. A request that doesn't offer the choice opens in T3 Code instead. Touch and hold the strip to read a long request in full.

send.promptPlaceholder: Run the tests and fix what fails
send.hint: Goes to the thread selected in T3 Code: it starts a turn, or steers or queues behind a running one. Hold the key to interrupt and restart with it.

steer.promptPlaceholder: Keep the change small and skip the refactor
steer.hint: Adds to the selected thread's running turn. It's dimmed while the thread is idle.

new.promptPlaceholder: Optional: Review the open pull request
new.title: Thread title
new.hint: With a prompt, the thread starts working and the deck selects it. Without one, it opens empty in T3 Code. With no thread selected, it starts with no project. It uses T3 Code's default model and access.
new.worktreeHint: A new worktree starts from the repository's default branch, as T3 Code's composer does, and takes its branch name from the prompt; it needs a prompt and a project.

model.hint: Cycling steps through T3 Code's favorite models, across providers, or the thread's provider's models when you have none. Picking another provider's model hands the thread over, as T3 Code's model picker does.

effort.hint: Cycling steps through the efforts the selected thread's model offers. A set effort its model doesn't offer dims the key. Ultrathink doesn't change the effort: like T3 Code, it prefixes the prompts the deck sends to that thread until you pick another effort.

permissions.hint: Applies to the selected thread from its next step. Only the modes its provider supports are offered.

approve.hint: Answers the selected thread's approval. A request that doesn't offer this choice, or that the deck can't answer, opens in T3 Code. Deny is its own key.

prompts.label: Prompts
prompts.templatesLabel: Add Continue, Fix tests, Diagnose, Explain and Commit
prompts.hint: Rotate to choose, press to send to the selected thread, hold to start a new thread.

threads.hint: Rotate through the matching threads, most urgent first; the one the dial rests on becomes T3 Code's selection. Press or tap opens it.

power.hint: Rotate to preview, press to apply to the selected thread. Model turns through T3 Code's favorite models across providers. Press with nothing to apply, or tap, to switch Speed when the model offers it. Ultrathink, where Claude offers it, prefixes the deck's next prompts to the thread.

limits.hint: Pooled across the provider's accounts on the chosen machines, as T3 Code's Limits shows it. Tap refreshes. The tick on the bar is where even pace would be.
limits.spendHint: Holding spends one reset credit on the account T3 Code would refill first. It needs provider access: if the pairing lacks it, the machine's next pair link asks for it.

usage.hint: T3 Code's API estimate for the period, across the chosen machines; a folder two machines share counts once. Tap reads again, hold also reloads model prices. Needs usage access.
usage.dialHint: Rotate from the period's total through each model, by cost. Press or tap reads again; a long press also reloads model prices. Needs usage access.

target.label: Target
target.hint: The key acts on this thread even when another is selected, and shows a small pin. Archived or deleted, it shows as not available until you pick another.

queue.hint: Follows the selected thread's queue. Press sends the shown message now: into the running turn where the provider takes steering, or as the next turn when nothing runs, which also releases a queue Stop held. Hold removes it.

task.label: Task
task.hint: Press runs the task now, as T3 Code's Run now does; it keeps its schedule. Tasks come from T3 Code's Settings → Scheduled tasks.
task.dialHint: Rotate through the machine's scheduled tasks. Press runs the shown one now; tap turns it off, and tapping again turns it back on.

skill.label: Skill
skill.extraPlaceholder: Optional: what to tell it, after the skill
skill.hint: Sends the skill to the thread as T3 Code's composer does ($name, then your text). Skills come from the thread's provider for its checkout: Codex, Claude and Antigravity list them.
skill.dialHint: Rotate through the thread's provider skills for its checkout. Press or tap runs the shown one, touch and hold reads its description.

workflow.hint: Stops the workflows the thread runs, as T3 Code's Lineage panel does. Only Claude's workflows can be stopped. Hold the key to stop; a stopped workflow can't be resumed.

lineage.forkHint: Forks the thread from its newest finished reply into a new thread, as T3 Code's fork button on that reply does, then opens the fork.
lineage.mergeHint: Merges a forked thread back into the thread it came from, as T3 Code's Merge does, then opens that thread. Hold the key to merge.

update.hint: Shows the T3 Code version on the machine picked below (this computer's when none is). Hold to update it to the newest release on its channel; a desktop app installs its own update and relaunches. T3 Code doesn't announce updates to the deck, so the key can't show one is waiting.
update.access: Needs update access, which lets this deck update and restart T3 Code there. The key's first press asks for it at the machine's next pairing.

script.label: Script
script.hint: Press runs the script in its own terminal on the thread, in its worktree or else the project's folder, as T3 Code's script button does. Hold stops it. The key shows whether it runs; T3 Code doesn't report a script's exit code, only its terminal's.
script.access: Shell access: this needs terminal access, which lets this deck run any command in T3 Code's terminals on that machine. The key's first press asks for it at the machine's next pairing.

share.hint: Press makes a guest link for the thread and copies it; anyone with it can watch the thread for 24 hours and propose messages you send or dismiss. Hold stops sharing. Needs Guest links (Settings → Labs) and T3 Connect.
share.access: Needs guest link access, which lets this deck share threads with people outside. The key's first press asks for it at the machine's next pairing.
share.linkHint: Shown only while Turnkey runs: T3 Code shows a link once, when it is made.

status.unpaired: Turnkey isn't paired with T3 Code yet.

urgent.name: Most urgent thread
urgent.description: Shows what needs you in T3 Code. Choose it to open that thread.

stop.name: Stop run
stop.description: Stops the T3 Code run that started last.

settings.description: Opens Turnkey Settings: machines, pairing and haptics.

status.name: Thread status
status.description: Shows how many T3 Code threads wait on you and how many run. Choose it to open the most urgent.

stopAll.name: Stop all runs
stopAll.description: Stops every running T3 Code thread.

prompt.description: Sends a prompt to the thread open in T3 Code.

continue.description: Nudges the thread open in T3 Code to continue; opens it when it waits on you.

limits.description: Shows your tightest T3 Code usage limit.

access.description: Scroll to change the access mode of the thread open in T3 Code; press for the next one.

effort.description: Scroll to change the effort of the thread open in T3 Code; press for the next level.

send.name: Send prompt
send.description: Sends the prompt you write here to the thread open in T3 Code.

page.hapticsHint: Buzz an MX Master 4 when a thread needs approval, asks a question, finishes or fails. Options+ lists each buzz under Turnkey's events.
page.paired: Paired with {name}. You can close this page.
